description:
Get one company's current registry card: the same answer as the REST API's
GET /v1/companies/{slug}.

Use it for "who runs it, who owns it, what capital": officers (the current
roles derived from the published acts), sole_shareholder as printed,
capital_eur, address, status, NIF with its source, public_contracts and
a size_hint estimate. For the dated acts use company_history. A name is
searched as in company_history: several matches return {ambiguous: true,
candidates, candidate_names with name, province and status}, none returns
{error, suggested_companies}.

Returns JSON with company_slug, company_name, current_name, status,
officers, sole_shareholder, capital_eur, nif, nif_caveat, sources and the
other snapshot fields, plus former_slugs for a merged company. BORME
publishes no minority shareholdings, employees or revenue.

Read-only; one request per call. Needs the basic plan or higher: send your
API key in the X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

company.description: Company slug, e.g. vaz-metales-sl (from search_companies), or a name of at least 3 letters or digits, e.g. "Mercadona", searched case-insensitively as in company_history.
company.title: Company
